d:
Bhagalpur has plenty to offer beyond its famous non-vegetarian food, and in this episode, we set out to explore the city’s vegetarian side. From hot imarti and spicy kachori to sattu, singhara, bhunja, traditional sweets and handi chai, this food trail took us through some of Bhagalpur’s much-loved local food spots.
Our first stop was Babulal Sweets, where we had freshly made, hot imarti prepared with urad dal and rice flour. We paired it with a spicy kachori and a hearty aloo-chana sabzi, served on a leaf plate folded into a traditional cone. We ended our stop with rasgulla and pantua.
